declaration.rule_verbatim: The window must contain, for EVERY input in the fusion's population, either (a) at least TWO OBSERVED CHANGES of that input, or (b) an explicit FROZEN declaration for it.
declaration.why_not_declared_cadence: L4-C02, measured over the 72 v3.1 cards at cf66984cfc: declared_rhythm NULL on 47 of 72, and of the 19 where live_matches_declared was measured, 11 read 'no'. A window resting on DECLARED cadence rests on a field absent two thirds of the time and wrong in a majority of checked cases. OBSERVED change is the right input.

observation.instrument: git log --format=%H over each declared input path; distinct commits = observed changes
observation.window: ALL HISTORY AVAILABLE AT d56e1f5bba -- this is NOT yet a nightly-run window. L4-C02's floor is 7 consecutive nightly runs; none have occurred for this fusion. The census is emitted so N can be re-derived when they have.
observation.positive_control: the same accessor over CLAUDE.md returns 195 commits (fires) and over a non-existent path returns 0 without erroring -- so a zero here is a real zero, not an instrument failure
observation.failure_look: a FALSE count would come from reading a path the input does not actually live at (the count would be 0 or wrong while the input is live); the paths are copied from the rectangle's inputs block rather than typed, and every one resolves

verdict.statement: 6 of 8 declared inputs carry >=2 observed changes. 2 carry exactly ONE and NO input carries a FROZEN declaration, so L4-C02 IS NOT YET SATISFIED for ['boundary_declarations', 'andrew_record']. This is the honest state of the window, not a failure of the fusion: it says N may not yet be re-derived as though those inputs had been observed to move.

findings.statement: 2 of 8 declared inputs carry NO pin: ['prd', 'andrew_record']. Certification arm 2 says 'an unpinned input is not an input'. Raised to the certifier and the rectangle's issuer; not repaired here -- no edit to the rectangle is in this face's scope.

disposition.remediation: Certification Addendum 1 @2961a22d4f binds both pins EXTERNALLY (andrew_record and prd -> ca2079d0ad) without editing a byte of the sealed rectangle (sha 019e3996...e943 unchanged). So the finding's statement remains TRUE OF THE SEALED ARTIFACT -- the inputs block still carries no pin on those two -- and is satisfied by the addendum that binds them.
disposition.independently_verified_here: this seat re-derived the arithmetic from the rectangle's key structure rather than relaying the certifier's count: 5 inputs carry `pin`, 1 carries `settled_pin`, 2 carry neither = 8, the declared population. The addendum's 6+1+2 sums to 9 and exceeds the population by one -- a double-count of the single `settled_pin` row (bridge_registry). Different route, same conclusion, so this is corroboration and not repetition.
disposition.effect_on_this_census: NONE. This census classified an input as pinned if it carried EITHER key, giving 6 pinned / 2 unpinned over a denominator of 8 -- unaffected by the addendum's double-count. No count, class or verdict in this artifact moves.
disposition.addendum_pin_history: CITE @2961a22d4f. It SUPERSEDES @9f6b63f765 per the issuer's instruction (msg 80651): the addendum's own input_pin_census read '6 pinned under `pin`' and is corrected to '5', which is the defect 3.0.0_SA_CVO~X refused the hold lift on and this seat independently re-derived from the rectangle's key structure. The corrected census now reads 5 `pin` + 1 `settled_pin` + 2 bound = 8, matching this seat's derivation exactly. The earlier pin is recorded rather than erased so a reader meeting a @9f6b63f765 citation elsewhere knows it is superseded, not wrong about the pins it bound -- those were correct at both commits.
disposition.closed_on: 3.0.0_SA_CVO~X GO 034433Z, after its independent re-read PASSed the CORRECTED Addendum 1 at 2961a22d4f. The certifier lifted this finding only -- stability/fusion-dependent work remains held.
disposition.what_closure_does_NOT_mean: The sealed rectangle's `inputs.prd` and `inputs.andrew_record` REMAIN FIELD-UNPINNED in the artifact itself -- the addendum binds them EXTERNALLY and edits no byte of the sealed file (sha 019e3996...e943 unchanged). So the original observation stays true of the sealed artifact; what closed is the OBLIGATION, because the pins are now bound and citable. A reader must not take CLOSED to mean the rectangle's inputs block was repaired -- it was not, deliberately, because editing it would destroy the seal the certification attests.

reading_note_which_window.source: 1.0.0_SA_CTO~X (L4-C02's declarant), msg 80557 2026-08-29T03:19:52Z, DESIGN READ of this artifact
reading_note_which_window.carried_here_because: the clarification arrived as a broker message and this artifact is the durable carrier that outlives it. A correction is only as complete as its last surviving carrier -- this project has twice paid for a fix that landed in one carrier and not the one readers actually open.
reading_note_which_window.clarification: THIS CENSUS MEASURES ALL HISTORY AT HEAD, so it answers 'has this input EVER moved twice'. That SIZES THE FLOOR -- an input that has never moved twice in its whole history will not move twice in 7 nights, which is the frozen-or-slow signal. It is NOT the in-window census. L4-C02's GATE census is re-run at L4 by the same instrument over the N-run window (commits between run 1 and run N per input), and THAT verdict is the gate.
reading_note_which_window.therefore: `verdict.l4c02_satisfied: false` here MUST NOT be read as 'L4-C02 fails'. It is the floor-sizing input reporting that two inputs have not yet been observed to move twice in all of history.
reading_note_which_window.and_at_l4: the declarant states that `andrew_record` (a sovereign record) and `boundary_declarations` (the declaration file) are DOCUMENTS that BIND the experiment, not fusion inputs whose nightly drift a persistence rate must survive -- waiting for a ruling to change twice is not a persistence measurement. At L4 they are declared FROZEN-BY-KIND by the declarant and the census then reads 6 observed + 2 frozen = 8 of 8.
reading_note_which_window.NOT_APPLIED_HERE_AND_WHY: the declarant explicitly did NOT ask this lane to declare them frozen now: 'declaring inputs frozen is L4's act on its own window, and doing it in wave 2 would be the declarant reaching into the executor's artifact to make the verdict read clean.' No frozen_declaration was set. The census stands as emitted and its verdict is unchanged.
